name: What is the process for starting a rental property renovation project?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for starting a rental property renovation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The renovation process typically begins with defining your project goals and budget. Next, you'll consult with general contractors to obtain quotes and select the best fit. Once a contractor is chosen, detailed planning and design occur, followed by necessary permit applications. Construction then commences, involving demolition, structural work, rough-ins for electrical and plumbing, and then finishing work. Regular communication with your contractor is crucial throughout to monitor progress and address any issues until final inspection and completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves defining goals, hiring a contractor, detailed planning, permit application, construction (demolition to finishing), and final inspection.
